parsed.post: Discarding ASPECT_RATIO=64 experiment (1.0433 vs 1.0373). It seems increasing the aspect ratio from 48 to 64 was detrimental in this specific regime. Reverting to my best configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=48, LR=0.08, WARMUP=0.05). Next: testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.09) to see if we can find a better peak without instability.
parsed.description: Reverting to best known ASPECT_RATIO=48 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.09 to find a better convergence point.
